要是搁以前，吴姜肯定也会以为是哪位同学无聊，编出来的谣言。

现在嘛，他很确定，那几件东西绝对不干净。

只是，他的关注点已经不在这了，“刚入学就有学长专门给你说这些八卦，还说得这么详细，是不是看上你了？”

李月芽傲娇的扬起下巴，“哼，看上我的多了去了。”

吴姜撇了撇嘴，心里莫名有些不爽，想说些反驳的话，可话到嘴边，又硬生生忍住了。

一顿饭吃了将近一个小时，李月芽吃得不亦乐乎，嘴角都沾了点酱汁，吴姜看着，下意识地递过一张纸巾，语气依旧带着吐槽：“吃慢点，没人跟你抢，看看你，都快吃成小花猫了。”

李月芽愣了一下，接过纸巾擦了擦嘴角，脸颊微微发红，小声嘟囔了一句“知道了”，却没再怼他。吃完饭，吴姜结了账，两人一起走出私房菜，李月芽心情大好，主动说道：“行吧，看在你今天表现不错的份上，我就原谅你了，回头把你微信加回来。”

“那就多谢姑奶奶开恩了。”吴姜调侃了一句，“走吧，我送你回学校，我也该回去工作了，不然老妈又该唠叨了。”

吴姜开车将李月芽送到学校门口，这次没有像上次那样开进学校，只是停在门口，等李月芽步入校园、身影渐渐消失在人群中后，他才转身发动车子，径直往古玩城的方向赶。

等他回到古玩城，推开自家店门，才发现店里空荡荡的，老爹吴时安和李叔早就出发去泾县进货了，只剩下王大雷一个人坐在柜台后面，低头玩着手机，时不时抬头瞥一眼门口。

“小姜，你回来了？”王大雷听到动静，抬头看了他一眼，笑着放下手机，说道，“吴叔和李叔早就走了，走之前还特意嘱咐我，让你小子好好学，别偷懒。”

吴姜点了点头，随意找了个凳子坐下，有些无聊地说道：“知道了，王哥。”

If it had been in the past, Wu Jiang would definitely have thought that some classmate was bored and made up the rumor.

Now, he was sure that those things were definitely not clean.

However, his focus is no longer on this. "When you first entered school, there was a senior who told you these gossips, and he told you in such detail. Did he take a fancy to you?"

Li Yueya raised her chin proudly, "Humph, you're attracted to me a lot."

Wu Jiang curled his lips, feeling inexplicably unhappy. He wanted to say something to refute, but when the words came to his lips, he held them back.

The meal lasted for nearly an hour. Li Yueya ate so much that there was some sauce on the corner of his mouth. Wu Jiang looked at it and subconsciously handed over a tissue. His tone was still complaining: "Eat slowly, no one will compete with you. Look at you, you are almost turning into a little cat."

Li Yueya was stunned for a moment, then took the tissue and wiped the corners of her mouth. Her cheeks turned slightly red, and she muttered "I know" in a low voice, but did not attack him again.After finishing the meal, Wu Jiang paid the bill, and the two of them walked out of the private dining room together. Li Yueya was in a good mood and said proactively: "Okay, seeing as you performed well today, I will forgive you and I will add you back on WeChat later."

"Then thank you for your kindness, grandma." Wu Jiang joked, "Let's go, I'll take you back to school. It's time for me to go back to work, otherwise my mother will be nagging me again."

Wu Jiang drove Li Yueya to the school gate. This time he did not drive into the school like last time. He just stopped at the gate. After Li Yueya entered the campus and her figure gradually disappeared from the crowd, he turned around and started the car and headed straight for the antique city.

When he returned to the antique city and opened the door of his store, he found that the store was empty. His father Wu Shi'an and Uncle Li had already left for Jingxian County to purchase goods. Wang Dalei was the only one left sitting behind the counter, playing with his mobile phone with his head down and glancing up at the door from time to time.

"Xiao Jiang, are you back?" Wang Dalei heard the noise, looked up at him, put down his phone with a smile, and said, "Uncle Wu and Uncle Li left long ago. Before they left, they specifically told me to study hard and don't be lazy."

Wu Jiang nodded, found a stool to sit down at random, and said somewhat boredly: "I know, Brother Wang."
